[Date sent]

To: [Medicaid plan appeals department and mailing or electronic submission address]

Re: Appeal of denial of prior authorization  
Member: Emerson Mercado  
Member ID: W599128801  
Requested service: Total hip replacement  
CPT: 27130  
Reference number: POC-2A69B0B828-71504  
Date of adverse benefit determination: July 31, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for total hip replacement, CPT 27130. The notice states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity.

The submitted clinical records support the medical necessity of the requested procedure:

- Emerson Mercado has experienced 14 months of progressive hip pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- Conservative treatment has been appropriately attempted and has not provided adequate relief. This includes 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy focused on hip abductor strengthening and gait from February 27, 2026, through June 5, 2026, with 16 completed visits. The therapy discharge note documents this treatment.
- NSAIDs were used for four months with inadequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on March 30, 2026, provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiographs obtained July 5, 2026, show superolateral joint-space narrowing to 1 mm, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophytes.
- The condition substantially limits activities of daily living and mobility. Emerson ambulates with a cane, can walk only one block, and cannot put on shoes without assistance.
- Examination documents positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- The records also document no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and non-smoking status.
- The requested procedure is being recommended by Okafor, MD, an orthopedic surgeon.

Taken together, these records document persistent and progressive symptoms, objective structural hip disease, failure of multiple conservative treatments, significant functional impairment, and a treating orthopedic surgeon’s recommendation for total hip replacement. They address the clinical information needed to evaluate medical necessity and should permit review of the request.

Please overturn the denial and authorize CPT 27130. If the plan continues to believe that the record is incomplete, please identify each specific missing document or clinical fact, explain why it is required, and allow submission of that information for reconsideration.

The applicable governing policy and clinical-review criteria have not been identified in the denial notice, and no plan medical policy is quoted in this appeal. Please provide the exact policy or clinical criteria applied to this request, including its title, policy number, version or effective date, and the specific criteria used to evaluate CPT 27130. Please also provide the clinical-review file and the identity and qualifications of the reviewer responsible for the determination.

Please treat this letter as a timely appeal. The notice states that the appeal must be received by January 27, 2027. Please send written confirmation of receipt and the appeal determination to:

[Emerson Mercado’s mailing address]  
[Emerson Mercado’s telephone number]  
[Emerson Mercado’s email address, if applicable]

Sincerely,

Emerson Mercado  
Member ID: W599128801

Enclosures:

- July 5, 2026 weight-bearing AP pelvis radiograph report
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 16 visits from February 27, 2026, through June 5, 2026
- Medication and conservative-treatment history
- March 30, 2026 corticosteroid injection record
- Orthopedic examination and treatment plan from Okafor, MD
- Prior authorization denial notice
